name: eslint
cmd: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js scripts/quality/prepare-native-ui.cjs src/components/memory/MemoryPageTurn.tsx src/screens/profile/MemoryAlbumScreen.tsx tests/quality/memory-page-turn.cjs tests/quality/native-auth-diagnostics.cjs tests/quality/native-emulator-graphics.cjs tests/quality/native-emulator-host-diagnostics.cjs tests/quality/native-ios-url-trace.cjs tests/quality/native-memory-album-loading.cjs > /tmp/platinum-v9-combined-static/eslint.log.txt 2>&1

name: python-syntax
cmd:
python3 - <<'PY' > /tmp/platinum-v9-combined-static/python-syntax.log.txt 2>&1
import ast
from pathlib import Path
for name in ['scripts/quality/native-ui-emulator-graphics.py','scripts/quality/native-ui-emulator-host-diagnostics.py','scripts/quality/native-ui-ios-url-trace.py']:
 ast.parse(Path(name).read_text(),filename=name)
 print(name+': Python AST parsed')
PY

name: bash-syntax
cmd: for gate_file in scripts/quality/test-android-app-ui.sh scripts/quality/test-ios-app-ui.sh; do bash -n "$gate_file" || exit "$?"; done > /tmp/platinum-v9-combined-static/bash-syntax.log.txt 2>&1

name: node-syntax
cmd: for gate_file in scripts/quality/prepare-native-ui.cjs tests/quality/memory-page-turn.cjs tests/quality/native-auth-diagnostics.cjs tests/quality/native-emulator-graphics.cjs tests/quality/native-emulator-host-diagnostics.cjs tests/quality/native-ios-url-trace.cjs tests/quality/native-memory-album-loading.cjs; do node --check "$gate_file" || exit "$?"; done > /tmp/platinum-v9-combined-static/node-syntax.log.txt 2>&1

name: yaml-syntax
cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const YAML=require("yaml");const value=YAML.parse(fs.readFileSync(".github/workflows/native-app-ui.yml","utf8"));if(!value.jobs||!value.name)throw Error("Invalid workflow structure");process.stdout.write("native-app-ui.yml: YAML parsed\n");' > /tmp/platinum-v9-combined-static/yaml-syntax.log.txt 2>&1

name: whitespace
cmd:
git diff --check b5c9c82b3b507e0bf6ecc6b9290e34740d32f3f6 -- .github/workflows/native-app-ui.yml scripts/quality/prepare-native-ui.cjs scripts/quality/test-android-app-ui.sh scripts/quality/test-ios-app-ui.sh src/components/memory/MemoryPageTurn.tsx src/screens/profile/MemoryAlbumScreen.tsx tests/quality/memory-page-turn.cjs tests/quality/native-auth-diagnostics.cjs tests/quality/native-memory-album-loading.cjs > /tmp/platinum-v9-combined-static/whitespace.log.txt 2>&1
tracked_status=$?
if [ "$tracked_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$tracked_status"; fi
for gate_file in scripts/quality/native-ui-emulator-graphics.py scripts/quality/native-ui-emulator-host-diagnostics.py scripts/quality/native-ui-ios-url-trace.py tests/quality/native-emulator-graphics.cjs tests/quality/native-emulator-host-diagnostics.cjs tests/quality/native-ios-url-trace.cjs; do git diff --no-index --check -- /dev/null "$gate_file" >> /tmp/platinum-v9-combined-static/whitespace.log.txt 2>&1 || exit "$?"; done
